configuration:
# preserve fixture comment
[account_pool]
enabled=true
strategy='round_robin'
[unrelated]
keep='untouched'
observation_boundaries: public cases use actual Register and JSON-RPC schema/typed binding/handler through saved Go Facade with empty owned DB and preserved configuration
open/config/gate/manager counters are internal Go boundary observations; zero-effects and persisted configuration/accounts have public Rust equivalents

go_private_selection uses twenty identical entries and genuine SDK recommendation plus injected manager to observe handler count/pages/quality/mode/runtime defaults; this is Go-only and is not a stub-success RPC golden for Rust
raw request strings retain decimal/exponent/overflow JSON spellings; expected protocol messages are observed, not manually reconstructed

count.description: optional artwork count; defaults to 5; explicit value must be from 1 to 20

pages.description: 1-based page selection, e.g. 1,3-5; default all pages

quality.description: static image quality: original, regular, small, thumb, mini

ugoira_mode.description: ugoira output mode: gif, apng, zip, or raw; default gif

main_download_tool.description: Download artwork IDs or supported Pixiv artwork/user URLs with intelligent storage rules.

pages.description: 1-based page selection, e.g. 1,3-5; default all pages

quality.description: static image quality: original, regular, small, thumb, mini

src.description: PID, Pixiv artwork/user URL, or allowed CDN resource URL

srcs.description: multiple PID, Pixiv artwork/user URL, or allowed CDN resource URLs

ugoira_mode.description: ugoira output mode: gif, apng, zip, or raw; default gif
